name: titan
description: Read and update your Titan workouts, nutrition and body weight through your own account.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Titan account to review your training, nutrition and weigh-ins from ChatGPT. Log a whole meal in one go, save your usual meals, find foods you ate before, run a progress check-in, update your routine or coaching profile, and check your workout history. Changes are saved to your Titan account and sync to your app; proposed plan changes wait for your approval. Requires a Titan account with active access and your explicit authorization; without access, ChatGPT cannot read or change your Titan data. Titan is a tracking tool, not medical advice.
defaultPrompt: Show my nutrition totals for today.

publication.release_notes: Adds meals (log a whole meal in one call, add to or move a meal), progress check-ins with proposals the user accepts in the app, the My coaching profile, the weekly training target and automations. The skill explains when to use each.
